sections.Profile:
The Ali pinball machine, manufactured by Stern Electronics in 1980, celebrates the legendary boxer Muhammad Ali. Designed by Harry Williams with artwork by Bob Timm, this solid-state pinball game features vibrant backglass art depicting Ali in action, one of the few games from that era to prominently feature African Americans.

- Manufacturer: Stern Electronics
- Years made: 1980
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Licensed, Sports, Stern Electronics, Boxing, Solid State, 1980s
